name: vscode-serial-monitor-oss
description: Monitor serial ports in VS Code, with tag highlighting, filtering, and scroll lock.

serialMonitor.maxBufferLines.description: Receive buffer cap in lines; the oldest lines drop out beyond it (applies live).

serialMonitor.recentBaudRates.description: Recently used baud rates, shown first in the quick-pick.

serialMonitor.logDirectory.description: Directory for per-session serial logs: each monitoring session creates a new timestamped .log file there.

serialMonitor.timestamps.description: Show a receive timestamp at the start of each line (display decoration only; tag matching always uses raw line content).

serialMonitor.tags.markdownDescription: Tags: named row-matching rules (pattern + color + highlight/filter flags) consumed by highlighting and filtering. Usually managed from the monitor UI.

id.description: Stable identity used by the UI (assigned automatically).

pattern.description: Literal substring, or regex source when isRegex is true.

isRegex.description: Whether pattern is a regular expression instead of a substring.

color.description: Hex color used for the full-line highlight and the chip.

filter.description: Participates in filtering (with the global filter mode).

enabled.description: Legacy single switch; migrated to highlight/filter on load.

scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node scripts/build-integration.mjs && node scripts/stop-feeder.mjs && node dist/integration/runTest.js
